name: Virtue USD
oneLiner: VUSD is Virtue Money's CDP dollar on IOTA, minted by borrowing against overcollateralized IOTA and stIOTA positions with liquidation defending the peg.
collateral: Overcollateralized IOTA, stIOTA, vIOTA, and iBTC positions backing VUSD debt inside the Virtue Money protocol
pegMechanism: CDP-style mint: users borrow VUSD against IOTA or stIOTA collateral and repay debt to unlock collateral, with liquidation and redemption mechanics supporting the U.S. dollar peg

notices.title: August 2026 oracle exploit; protocol relaunched October 19
notices.message: On 28 August 2026 an attacker took control of all fourteen Switchboard IOTA oracle signing keys, reported $10,000,000 per IOTA, and minted 4,942,737.62 VUSD against 1.027 IOTA of collateral, reducing protocol-wide backing to 8.0%. The manipulated feed then triggered 47 liquidation events across 45 users and the protocol was frozen. Virtue relaunched on 19 October 2026 with a peg stability module that mints VUSD 1:1 against USDT0. The attacker-held VUSD has not been burned. Sources: Virtue post-incident report https://x.com/Virtue_Money/article/2094074502447825150 and the 19 October relaunch update https://x.com/Virtue_Money.
